title: The forgetful functor from abelian groups to sets preserves filtered colimits
statement: For every universe $u$, the forgetful functor from abelian groups with underlying sets in universe $u$ to sets in universe $u$ preserves filtered colimits: for every small filtered category $I$ in universe $u$, diagram $F:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$, and colimit cocone $(A,(c_i)_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the underlying set of $A$, with the underlying maps of the $c_i$, is a colimit of the underlying-set diagram.

proof.text: Apply the instance AddCommGrpCat.FilteredColimits.forget_preservesFilteredColimits, generated by to_additive from CommGrpCat.FilteredColimits.forget_preservesFilteredColimits at lines 212-215. Its PreservesFilteredColimits assertion is exactly preservation for every small filtered diagram.
